Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-023 - External task completion conflict prevents duplicate app decision

parameters.script: const body=document.body.innerText; const key='EFREG023-ExternalComplete-EFQA-20260924T1400'; const cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article,section,[class*="card"]')).map(e=>(e.innerText||'').trim()).filter(t=>t.includes(key)); return {href:location.href,queue:(body.match(/\d+ expenses waiting on[^\n]*/)||[])[0]||null,cardCount:cards.length,taskCount:(body.match(/101647510/g)||[]).length,expenseCount:(body.match(/EXP-1030/g)||[]).length,cardText:cards[0]||null};
